title: New growth_districts catalog block parses via truncating jint — values >= 2^32 wrap silently past the 1..1000/0..1000 fail-fast gates, violating the repo's own jint_strict hardening bar
location: core/catalog.odin:966-982 (block introduced by this PR, commit 044a6d2; data side: data/balance.json growth_districts)
detail: The fail-fast range checks run after jint's truncating i32 cast, so an out-of-i32-range integer wraps into the accepted 1..1000/0..1000 domain and a decimal truncates silently — the exact anti-pattern the repo's documented 4.2 hardening (jint_strict) forbids for new blocks.
recommended_fix: Parse the growth_districts block with jint_strict (reject |v| > i32::MAX, json.Float decimals, wrong-typed values), per the 4.2 bar for new catalog blocks; keep the 1..1000 / 0..1000 range checks after the strict parse.
